summary: Valens Semiconductor Ltd. files Form 6-K furnishing a notice and proxy statement for its annual general meeting of shareholders scheduled for July 30, 2026. The meeting agenda includes routine items such as electing a Class II director, approving compensation policy, and re-appointing auditors. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or other extraordinary corporate action—is disclosed. This is a standard routine current report for a foreign private issuer conducting an ordinary annual meeting, with no deal terms or unusual structural mechanics to analyze. The filing incorporates the proxy materials by reference into existing registration statements.
